test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Suresh speaks French here.

options.text: French is spoken here by Suresh.
French is been spoken here by Suresh.
French was spoken here by Suresh.
French are spoken here by Suresh.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **given sentence**, we have an **active form **where the subject "Suresh" is performing the action of speaking French.
 
• **To convert this** sentence into the passive form,** we need to** make the object "French" the subject and the subject "Suresh" the object of the sentence.
 
• In the passive voice,** the structure is**: Object + is/are + past participle + by + subject.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'French is spoken here by Suresh.'*
